title: Project box with lid (IR v1)
prompt: Two-part project box, printed side by side. The box is 90 x 60 mm outside and 30 mm tall, open at the top, with a 2 mm floor and 2 mm walls. The lid is a flat 90 x 60 x 2 mm plate with a 4 mm tall, 1.2 mm thick locating lip on top that fits inside the box with 0.2 mm clearance all round (so the lip is 85.6 x 55.6 outside); I'll flip it over to use it. Put the box's corner at the origin and the lid 10 mm to the right (+X) of the box, everything sitting on Z = 0.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Two solid parts: the box and the lid (the lip joined to the lid)
Box and lid side by side span 190 × 60 × 30 mm
Box corner at the origin, on Z = 0
A 90 × 60 × 30 open box with 2 mm walls and floor (27152 mm³)
The lid: 90 × 60, 6 mm high with its lip, 10 mm right of the box (12132 mm³)

notes: IR v1 rewrite of t2-enclosure-with-lid: the box is a shelled solid and the lip is joined to the lid, so there are exactly 2 bodies (v0 needed separate wall bodies). Box 90·60·30 − 86·56·28 = 27152; lid 10800 + lip (85.6·55.6 − 83.2·53.2)·4 = 1332.48.
